subject.title: fix(telegram): route poll answers into sessions

question: Should OpenClaw treat authorized answers to its non-anonymous Telegram polls as actionable agent/session events rather than display-only Telegram UI interactions?
rationale: The canonical issue explicitly leaves open either routing votes into agent turns or documenting that votes are display-only; the proposed behavior creates a new inbound agent-turn contract even though it fixes an observable workflow gap.

options.title: Sponsor routed poll answers
options.body: Confirm that authorized public poll votes should enter the originating direct or topic session, subject to live proof of correct routing.

options.title: Keep polls display-only
options.body: Decline the new inbound-turn contract and document that Telegram poll votes are not actionable, closing this implementation path.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Pause this PR until channel owners define the durable approval and poll-vote interaction model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor routed poll answers
recommendation.body: Confirm that authorized public poll votes should enter the originating direct or topic session, subject to live proof of correct routing.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest evidence-backed historical owner candidate for the merged Telegram poll action that this PR extends.
